name: liquefy-ui
description: A transparent, tactile Liquid Glass UI system for React.

scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm verify:rsc
scripts.generate: node scripts/build-mcp-catalog.mjs && node scripts/build-registry.mjs && node scripts/build-llms.mjs && node scripts/copy-brand.mjs
scripts.pack:packages: rm -rf .tarballs && mkdir -p .tarballs && pnpm --filter @liquefy-ui/core --filter @liquefy-ui/icons --filter @liquefy-ui/react exec pnpm pack --pack-destination ../../.tarballs
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
